help_scope.message:
**Choose which accounts to observe.**

Blue-only skips accounts without confirmed blue verification; verification is not AI evidence.

Requires automatic observation.

help_policy.message:
**Presets change probability and model confidence only.**

Editing a slider selects Custom.

Reply counts, thread counts and recent hit ratio stay unchanged.

help_suspect.message:
**In cumulative mode, the suspect-category probability needed to count a reply.**

Individual confidence and cumulative account conditions also apply.

Combined mode uses its own threshold.

help_confidence.message:
**Confidence in an individual classification, separate from category probability; both must pass.**

Cumulative detection also needs count conditions.

Combined mode has its own confidence setting.

help_hits.message:
**Minimum distinct qualifying replies from one account.**

Thread count and recent hit ratio must also pass.

Reloads and cache hits do not count again.

help_threads.message:
**Minimum distinct original posts containing qualifying replies.**

Several replies in one thread count as one post.

All cumulative conditions must pass.

Higher is stricter; this cannot exceed the reply count.

help_rate.message:
**Cumulative mode only: suspicious share of the latest five valid judgments.**

Low-confidence and unselected uncertain results are excluded.

Reply and thread counts must also pass.

help_retention.message:
**How long observation evidence is kept locally.**

Expired evidence no longer counts or enters reviews; existing blocks remain.

Separate from the request cache’s fixed 30-day lifetime.

help_daily.message:
**Daily model-request cap for AI detection.**

Cumulative counts each request; combined collection costs no requests and each batch counts once.

Cache hits are excluded; failed requests count.

Resets at midnight UTC.

Group-blocking tasks are separate.

help_following.message:
**Skip accounts you follow; wait when following status is unknown.**

Each module has its own switch.

The allowlist always takes priority.

help_markers.message:
**Cumulative mode only: shows individual probabilities.**

Combined mode makes no individual requests, so this is disabled.

Your choice is retained when switching back.

help_observer_mask.message:
**Cumulative mode only: mask a reply after its individual thresholds pass.**

Disabled in combined mode because individual judgments do not exist.

Qualified combined blocks still use removal animations.

help_review.message:
**Requires observation and extra model requests.**

Reviews up to 5 replies, at least 3 across 2 threads, respecting higher count settings; counts above 5 prevent review.

Uses probability, confidence and hit ratio.

At least 1 hour and 2 new replies between reviews.

Counts toward the daily limit; disabling deletes review text.

help_support.message:
**Probability threshold for support or selected blocking categories in a task you start.**

Model confidence must also pass.

Custom output categories change the target.

Higher is stricter.

help_mask.message:
**Applies only to a started group task.**

Mask probabilities from the lower bound up to the auto-block threshold; the upper bound follows that threshold.

Preserves height and can be revealed; it does not block the account.

help_auto_load.message:
**Automatically load more replies after you start a group task.**

Never starts a task itself.

More replies may increase model usage; turn it off in the task bar.

help_cache.message:
**Both modules share request caching by model, rules and context.**

Results expire after 30 days; least recently used entries are evicted first.

Clear cache removes request results, not evidence, history or allowlist.

Future requests may cost again.

help_endpoint.message:
**Shared Jev-compatible API endpoint.**

A new domain needs its own key and host permission, and must support the selected model.

Saving sends a validation request.

help_model.message:
**Model shared by both modules; must match the endpoint.**

Changing it separates cache and observation evidence so old model results are not mixed into new cumulative decisions.

help_observer_mode.message:
**Cumulative analyzes each reply and counts qualifying hits.**

Combined collects replies first and sends one grouped request when counts are met, with no individual requests.

Settings and evidence are separate between modes.

help_collect_replies.message:
**Collect 3–5 distinct replies before combined analysis.**

They need not be individually suspicious.

The separate thread requirement must also pass.

Independent of cumulative hit counts.

help_collect_threads.message:
**Required distinct threads among collected replies: 2–5, no more than the reply count.**

Counts combined-mode samples only; one comment thread counts once.

help_combined_probability.message:
**Required suspect-category probability for the grouped result.**

Combined confidence must also pass.

Independent of the cumulative single-reply threshold; does not produce individual scores.

help_combined_confidence.message:
**Confidence in the grouped classification.**

Must pass together with combined probability before blocking.

Stored separately from cumulative confidence.

help_combined_ratio.message:
**Minimum sample share the model must judge as showing the pattern.**

With 3 samples at 75%, all 3 are required.

This is a grouped criterion, not an average of individual scores or cumulative recent hit ratio.

modes_title.message: How do the two modes work?

modes_intro.message: Both work as you browse. Choose between judging replies individually and reviewing a collected group.

modes_cumulative.message:
**Assess each reply as you encounter it.**

An account enters the block queue only after enough suspicious replies meet your count, thread and recent-ratio requirements.

modes_combined.message:
**Collect replies, then assess them together.**

Only replies you encounter while browsing are collected. The extension does not visit profiles to fetch more. Collection uses no Jev requests and produces no individual scores.

modes_c2.message: Enough suspicious replies across enough threads

modes_c3.message: Recent ratio also qualifies → queue block

modes_b1.message: Encounter a reply → store it locally

modes_b2.message: Reply and thread counts qualify → assess together

modes_b3.message: Group probability and confidence qualify → queue block

modes_demo_intro.message: Imagine meeting the same account once in each of threads A, B and C. Both modes run side by side below.

modes_demo_note.message: Fixed example: 3 replies, 3 threads, 90% probability, 80% confidence and 75% ratio. Scores are illustrative. No model requests, account actions or setting changes are made.

modes_counts.message:
**Cumulative: count suspicious replies.** Three qualifying suspicious replies must come from three threads, and the recent ratio must qualify too.

**Combined: count collected replies.** They need not be judged suspicious first. Three replies across three threads trigger one group assessment.

Several replies in one conversation count as one thread. Refreshing the same reply never counts it again.

modes_scores.message:
**Probability: how closely the content matches a category you want to block.**

**Confidence: how certain the model is about its classification.** Both must qualify.

**Cumulative ratio: suspicious replies among up to five recent valid decisions.** Three out of four is 75%; unreliable decisions are excluded.

**Combined ratio: how many samples should exhibit the suspicious pattern.** 75% of three rounds up to three. It is not an average of individual scores.

modes_marks_title.message: Why are individual markers unavailable in combined mode?

modes_marks.message:
**No individual assessments means no individual scores.** Probability markers and early masking are unavailable in combined mode.

Removal animations and the background queue still run when the group qualifies. Switching back restores your previous marker and masking choices.

modes_cost.message:
**Cumulative: assess each eligible reply separately.**

**Combined: zero requests while collecting, one request when enough are collected.** That request contains more text, so fewer requests do not imply proportionally lower cost.

Identical requests can use cached results. Another group assessment requires at least one hour and two new replies. Both modes respect the daily request limit.

modes_shared.message:
**Enable automatic observation first.** The whitelist and enabled following protection apply; official @grok is excluded. Expired replies stop counting. Switching modes does not reuse the previous mode’s judgments.

A model probability is a judgment, not proof of who wrote the reply.
